import re

    r"\s*(?:(?P<hours>\d+)h)?\s*(?:(?P<minutes>\d+)m)?\s*",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

    ):

    hours = int(match.group("hours") or 0)
    minutes = int(match.group("minutes") or 0)
    return hours * 60 + minutes
